newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Toyota says may invest up to A$1 bln in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says may invest up to A$1 bln in Australia.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp on Monday announced plans to spend up to A$1 billion on new investment in Australia by 2005, almost doubling capacity of its local manufacturing base to around 140,000 cars per year.
Toyota Australia President Sam Komori said the figures were "ball park" and depended on the strength of local and export markets, but this was possible.
"We could reach as high as A$1 billion by the year 2005," Komori told a news conference where the company announced the manufacture of a new model in Australia.
The A$1 billion included A$80 million earmarked for the manufacture of the new six cylinder large car to roll off Toyota's Melbourne production from early year 2000.
